title: 275. Maximal Rectangle

examples.explanation: The 2x3 block of 1s in rows 2-3 (0-based rows 1-2), columns 1-3 has area 6.
The single cell forms a 1x1 rectangle.

hints: Build histogram heights column by column: reset to 0 on '0', else increment by 1.
Score each histogram with a monotone increasing stack, flushing with a sentinel 0 at the end.
Width for a popped bar is the distance to the new stack top minus one.
